input.request: Review the proposed CandidateEncoder reuse for this Java 17 application. Follow the selected receiver from receiver.properties through the factory and inspect the actual encode/decode boundary. Make the smallest justified encoder change, or preserve it if its output satisfies the deployed consumer contract. The Receiver implementations and selected configuration are fixed integration contracts for this task. Preserve record count, order and values, give a correctness check and a bounded plan for measuring any remaining cost hypothesis; no codec/dependency/toolchain upgrade or fabricated speedup.

must: Trace receiver.properties -> receiver(Properties) -> StreamReceiver, rather than assuming every byte[] is an independent member.
Recognize that the chunks plus final tail form one completed GZIP member and that the selected consumer reads that continuous stream.
Preserve a legitimate continuous-stream design, including SYNC_FLUSH where the delivery contract requires incremental visibility and eventual finish/trailer/close.
Validate full session decoding, count/order/values and a truncated final trailer negative control; avoid accepting a decoded prefix alone.

Describe performance as unmeasured. If measurement is needed, include the session's initialization, flush policy, finalization and equivalent record/byte denominators; do not compare unfinished chunks with complete independent messages.
